compose-config.description: Validate the Docker Compose file without starting anything. Part of lint-code, so the Lint leg of continuous-integration.yml runs it. Requires docker compose. Creates the workspace-root .env from .env.default when it is missing (the documented bootstrap; .env is gitignored) and never touches an existing one. Uncached on purpose: the compose file reads the workspace-root .env (env_file), which is gitignored and so cannot be declared as an input, and a cached pass would replay after .env goes missing or changes.

helm-lint.description: Lint every Helm release this repository ships with `helm lint --strict`, each chart layered with the values files its Argo CD Application uses. The `helm-releases` command of the deployment project discovers the releases from the chart folders, and helm-render runs it too, so lint and every render-based check judge the same set. Part of lint-code, so the Lint leg of continuous-integration.yml runs it. Requires helm on PATH (the devcontainer installs it; the GitHub-hosted runners ship it).

helm-render.description: Render every Helm release to dist/infrastructure/helm-render/<release>.yaml with helm template, using the values files each Argo CD Application passes. The single rendering that kubeconform, kube-linter, pluto, and trivy-config all consume, so no tool re-templates differently. Requires helm on PATH.

options.command: rm -rf dist/infrastructure/helm-render && NODE_OPTIONS='' node --import @swc-node/register/esm-register deployment/src/deployment.main.ts helm-releases render dist/infrastructure/helm-render

helm-test.description: Run the helm-unittest suites under every chart that has a tests folder. Part of lint-code, so the Lint leg of continuous-integration.yml runs it. Installs the helm-unittest v1.2.1 plugin when helm plugin list lacks unittest, for Linux amd64 or arm64 (the architecture picks its tarball, and any other platform fails before downloading). The tarball must match its hard-coded sha256 (that check is the integrity gate; both hashes match the release's helm-unittest-checksum.sha), then is copied into the plugins directory without its install hook, which would download the tarball again. Requires helm, curl, and sha256sum on PATH.

options.command: helm plugin list | awk 'NR > 1 { print $1 }' | grep -qx unittest || { case "$(uname -s)-$(uname -m)" in Linux-x86_64) a=amd64; s=48e86ecc1467b009630e5954375e5d8494139f73b466df5fe8c04fa45b634939;; Linux-aarch64|Linux-arm64) a=arm64; s=c66062713cd3cbb1a80d7098bd1d4a48db8438f56b43fb6377df65447f93f8de;; *) echo 'unsupported platform for the helm-unittest plugin: Linux amd64 or arm64 only' >&2; exit 1;; esac && d=$(mktemp -d) && curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSL -o "$d/helm-unittest.tgz" "https://github.com/helm-unittest/helm-unittest/releases/download/v1.2.1/helm-unittest-linux-$a-1.2.1.tgz" && echo "$s  $d/helm-unittest.tgz" | sha256sum -c - && mkdir "$d/plugin" && tar xzf "$d/helm-unittest.tgz" -C "$d/plugin" && sed -i '/^platformHooks:/,$d' "$d/plugin/plugin.yaml" && mkdir -p "$(helm env HELM_PLUGINS)/unittest" && cp -R "$d/plugin/." "$(helm env HELM_PLUGINS)/unittest/"; status=$?; rm -rf "$d"; [ "$status" -eq 0 ] || exit 1; }; for chart in {projectRoot}/helm/*/; do if [ -d "$chart/tests" ]; then helm unittest "$chart" || exit 1; fi; done

kube-linter.description: Lint the rendered manifests with kube-linter: its default checks plus the ones infrastructure/configuration/kube-linter.yaml names (read-only root filesystem, non-root, privilege escalation, resource requests and limits). Part of lint-code. Requires kube-linter on PATH.

kubeconform.description: Validate the rendered manifests against the Kubernetes 1.35.0 schemas and, for the Argo CD, CloudNativePG, Barman Cloud, and cert-manager custom resources, the datreeio/CRDs-catalog schemas. Strict (unknown fields fail), and a kind with no schema fails too: nothing is skipped. Part of lint-code. Requires kubeconform on PATH and network access to raw.githubusercontent.com, where the schemas are fetched.

open-webui.description: Manage the Open WebUI Docker service (up, down, open)

pluto.description: Detect Kubernetes API versions the rendered manifests use that 1.35.0 deprecates or has removed. A removed API fails the target; a deprecated one is printed as a warning and exits 0. Part of lint-code. Requires pluto on PATH.

recreate.command: docker compose -f {projectRoot}/docker/docker-compose.yml down -v postgres && docker compose -f {projectRoot}/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres

postgres.description: Start, stop, or recreate the local PostgreSQL container (recreate removes the volume)

searxng.description: Manage the SearxNG Docker service (up, down, open)

terraform-apply.description: Apply the organizzolini Terraform root, creating, updating, and deleting what a fresh plan finds. Needs the terraform-plan variables. Run by the Continuous Deployment workflow on main; run it locally only on purpose.

terraform-format.description: Check that the organizzolini Terraform is formatted. Part of lint-code. Requires terraform on PATH (the devcontainer installs it; CI uses hashicorp/setup-terraform).

terraform-init.description: Initialize the organizzolini Terraform root against its Linode Object Storage backend. Needs TF_STATE_BUCKET, AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3, AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.

terraform-plan.description: Plan the organizzolini Terraform root and write plan.tfplan beside it, without changing anything. Needs the terraform-init variables plus TF_VAR_openrouter_management_key, TF_VAR_github_token, TF_VAR_linode_token, TF_VAR_cloudflare_api_token, TF_VAR_cloudflare_account_id, and TF_VAR_cloudflare_zone_id.

terraform-test.description: Run the Terraform unit tests of the organizzolini root, against mock providers. Runs after terraform-validate because both run terraform init in the same root directory, and concurrent inits would corrupt .terraform and the lock file. Part of lint-code, so the Lint leg of continuous-integration.yml runs it. Needs no credentials: each root is initialized with -backend=false, so only the provider download needs network access. Requires terraform on PATH.

options.command: cd organizzolini && terraform init -input=false -backend=false && terraform test

terraform-validate.description: Validate the organizzolini Terraform without a backend or credentials. Part of lint-code. Requires terraform on PATH and downloads the providers, so it needs network access.

options.command: cd organizzolini && terraform init -input=false -backend=false && terraform validate

tflint.description: Lint the organizzolini Terraform root with tflint and its bundled terraform ruleset (preset all). The root uses its own .tflint.hcl when it has one, otherwise terraform/.tflint.hcl. The ruleset ships inside the pinned tflint binary, so there is no plugin download and no `tflint --init`, and nothing touches .terraform, so it may run beside the terraform targets. Part of lint-code. Requires tflint on PATH.

trivy-config.description: Scan Terraform infrastructure code and the rendered Helm manifests (helm-render) for misconfigurations using Trivy, both at CRITICAL and HIGH severity. Identical to what the Secure check runs, so a local run reproduces CI exactly. Requires trivy and helm on PATH (the devcontainer installs trivy; otherwise `brew install trivy`).

options.command: trivy config {projectRoot}/terraform --format table --severity CRITICAL,HIGH --exit-code 1 --ignorefile configuration/security/trivyignore && trivy config dist/infrastructure/helm-render --format table --severity CRITICAL,HIGH --exit-code 1 --ignorefile configuration/security/trivyignore
